notes: Timestamp column is not used as a model feature because the distributed CSV timestamps are rounded/scientific-notation values in the extracted files.
acc and gyro streams are taken from each recording and truncated to their common sample count; both are documented by the dataset as 20 Hz motion sensors.
The 'a' column is not used; the dataset paper describes it as the number-of-axes field.
Labels are recording-level (ADL=0, fall=1). Therefore windows cut from a fall recording are currently labeled 1; this is suitable for a first benchmark but is not an exact impact-time annotation.
Participant-held-out split prevents the same participant from appearing in train and test.
